services.name: Rent Common Room
services.description: A place on a shared sleeping-room bench or pallet, with a blanket and space beside it for your pack. Other guests may come and go. The price covers one person for one night, not the entire room. Meals, secure storage and stable care are separate. The GM decides whether the surroundings permit a rest; no rest is triggered automatically.
services.saleUnit: one person for one night
services.duration: 1 night(s); checkout at merchant time (default 10:00), GM may override

requirements.note: The GM confirms space, staff and timing before approving.

services.name: Rent Private Room
services.description: A small private room with a bed, simple bedding, washbasin and an inside latch. One booking covers up to two guests sharing the room for one night. Breakfast, laundry and animal care are not included. Agree extra occupants with the GM before approval. The room grants privacy, not automatic safety or a rest benefit.
services.saleUnit: one room for up to two guests for one night
services.duration: 1 night(s); checkout at merchant time (default 10:00), GM may override

requirements.note: The GM confirms space, staff and timing before approving.

services.name: Rent Luxury Room
services.description: A spacious private chamber with clean linen, a comfortable bed, a sitting corner and an attendant to bring hot washing water. One booking covers up to two guests for one night. Meals, full baths and personal errands cost extra. Fine furnishings confer no mechanical bonus, immunity from intrusion or guaranteed restful sleep.
services.saleUnit: one room for up to two guests for one night
services.duration: 1 night(s); checkout at merchant time (default 10:00), GM may override

requirements.note: The GM confirms space, staff and timing before approving.

services.name: Meal of the Day
services.description: A seat at the table and a filling serving from today's pot, with a piece of bread and drinking water. The kitchen chooses the dish; the GM confirms ingredients and substitutions. This pays for a meal served and eaten here. It creates no carried food Item, and the inn retains the bowl and utensils. Ale and other drinks are separate.
services.saleUnit: one served meal for one diner

requirements.note: The GM confirms space, staff and timing before approving.

services.name: Breakfast
services.description: A simple morning meal of porridge or bread with a small accompaniment and drinking water, served before the day's work. The kitchen fare determines the plate. This is one dine-in breakfast, not a takeaway portion or a daily ration. It creates no inventory Item; hot drinks, alcohol and additional plates are ordered separately.
services.saleUnit: one served breakfast for one diner

requirements.note: The GM confirms space, staff and timing before approving.

services.name: Dinner Package
services.description: A place for supper with a substantial main course, bread, a small sweet or cheese course and drinking water. One purchase feeds one diner. The GM agrees the evening menu before approval. This served package creates no food Items, does not include lodging or alcoholic drinks, and should not be charged again as individual menu portions.
services.saleUnit: one two-course dinner for one diner
services.duration: About one hour during evening kitchen hours

requirements.note: The GM confirms space, staff and timing before approving.

services.name: Stable Horse
services.description: A sheltered stall with bedding, water and routine mucking-out for one horse for up to a day. The stablehand keeps ordinary watch but does not insure the animal or its tack. Feed is charged separately through Feed Horse, or supplied by the owner with GM agreement. Veterinary treatment, training and transport are not included.
services.saleUnit: one stall for one horse for up to 24 hours

requirements.note: The GM confirms space, staff and timing before approving.

services.name: Feed Horse
services.description: The staff supplies and sets out an ordinary day's hay or equivalent fodder for one horse, with clean water. The GM confirms the animal's needs and any special diet. This pays for feed used on site and the attendant's work; no feed Item enters the character's inventory. A sheltered stall is separate. Packaged Horse Feed remains a product for carrying away.
services.saleUnit: one day of ordinary feed and feeding for one horse

requirements.note: The GM confirms space, staff and timing before approving.

services.name: Bath
services.description: A tub of warm water, a small measure of soap and a clean drying cloth in a screened bathing space. One purchase covers one person and one filling. The staff agrees a time before approval. The tub and cloth remain at the inn. Bathing has no automatic healing, disease removal or condition-clearing effect.
services.saleUnit: one bath for one person

requirements.note: The GM confirms space, staff and timing before approving.

services.name: Laundry
services.description: Staff washes and dries one ordinary outfit: shirt, trousers or skirt, underclothes and socks. The garments must be handed over and collected at an agreed time. Armour, leatherwork, delicate finery, heavy cloaks and repairs require a separate agreement. No equipment is automatically removed, repaired or replaced by checkout.
services.saleUnit: one ordinary outfit washed and dried
services.duration: Usually next day; weather may delay drying

requirements.note: The GM confirms space, staff and timing before approving.

services.name: Private Dining Room
services.description: Exclusive use of a separate dining room with a laid table and routine table service for up to eight guests during one sitting. Food and drinks are ordered separately. The GM confirms the time, capacity and actual privacy before approval. Hiring the room does not reserve lodging or guarantee secrecy, soundproofing or protection.
services.saleUnit: one room for up to eight guests for one sitting
services.duration: Up to three hours at an agreed time

requirements.note: The GM confirms space, staff and timing before approving.

services.name: Long-Term Lodging
services.description: A seven-night booking of an ordinary private room for up to two guests, with fresh bedding once during the stay. Meals, baths, laundry and stable care remain separate. The GM confirms dates and room availability before approval. Do not also charge nightly private-room rental for the same nights. Configured optional integrations can record the booking and issue a room key. No tenancy rights or rest automation is created.
services.saleUnit: one private room for up to two guests for seven nights
services.duration: 7 night(s); checkout at merchant time (default 10:00), GM may override

requirements.note: The GM confirms space, staff and timing before approving.

services.name: Meeting Room Hire
services.description: A quiet room with a table, chairs, ordinary lighting and a jug of drinking water for up to eight people. The innkeeper keeps routine interruptions away, but does not promise secrecy or soundproofing. Food, alcohol, guards and writing supplies are separate. The GM confirms the room and start time; no calendar reservation is created automatically.
services.saleUnit: one room for up to eight people for two hours
services.duration: Two hours at an agreed time

requirements.note: The GM confirms capacity, contents and timing before approving.

services.name: Secure Storage
services.description: The keeper records one parcel up to 20 lb and places it in the inn’s locked store for a day. Contents and identifying marks are agreed before payment. This is ordinary custody, not magical protection or insurance. Character Items are not moved or removed automatically; the GM records the handover and return. No Lock & Key key is issued for this service.
services.saleUnit: one parcel up to 20 lb in the inn’s locked store for one day
services.duration: Up to 24 hours; collection arranged with the keeper

requirements.note: The GM confirms capacity, contents and timing before approving.

services.name: Courier Message
services.description: A runner takes one folded message to a named address within the current settlement and reports whether it was delivered. Paper and sealing wax for that message are included. The GM agrees the recipient and likely delivery time; dangerous routes, replies and travel outside the settlement cost extra only by agreement. No chat message, Journal or external message is sent automatically.
services.saleUnit: one written message to one address within the settlement
services.duration: One local delivery attempt during working hours

requirements.note: The GM confirms capacity, contents and timing before approving.

services.name: Package Holding
services.description: One labelled parcel up to 10 lb is held behind the counter until its named recipient calls. This pays for ordinary short-term holding, not a locked store, delivery or insurance. The GM records who may collect it and handles any physical Item handover. Unclaimed parcels and extra days are settled by agreement, without automatic fees.
services.saleUnit: one labelled parcel up to 10 lb held behind the counter for one day

requirements.note: The GM confirms capacity, contents and timing before approving.

services.name: Repair Weapon
services.description: Straighten a minor bend, secure a loose head or replace a damaged grip. Major reconstruction and magical repairs require a separate agreement. Payment records the commissioned work; the GM decides completion and applies any item changes manually.

requirements.note: Select one eligible item from your character’s inventory. It stays with the character.

services.saleUnit: One weapon; minor repairs

services.name: Repair Armour
services.description: Replace a few damaged links, rivets or buckles and reshape minor dents. Missing sections, destroyed armour and magical repairs are excluded. Payment records the commissioned work; the GM decides completion and applies any item changes manually.

requirements.note: Select one eligible item from your character’s inventory. It stays with the character.

services.saleUnit: One suit; minor repairs

services.name: Sharpen Blade
services.description: Dress small nicks and restore an ordinary working edge. The service grants no attack or damage bonus. Payment records the commissioned work; the GM decides completion and applies any item changes manually.

requirements.note: Select one eligible item from your character’s inventory. It stays with the character.

services.saleUnit: One edged weapon

services.name: Silver a Weapon
services.description: Apply a durable silver finish to one suitable weapon using the 2014 silvering service price. The GM confirms suitability and manually marks the weapon as silvered after completion; no magical bonus is granted. Ammunition batches are not included. Payment records the commissioned work; the GM decides completion and applies any item changes manually.

requirements.note: Select one eligible item from your character’s inventory. It stays with the character.

services.saleUnit: One suitable weapon

services.name: Resize Armour
services.description: Adjust straps, padding and modest plate overlap to fit another wearer of a similar build. A change of creature size or complete reconstruction is not included. Payment records the commissioned work; the GM decides completion and applies any item changes manually.

requirements.note: Select one eligible item from your character’s inventory. It stays with the character.

services.saleUnit: One suit; same size class

services.name: Replace Bowstring
services.description: Fit and tension a replacement string for an ordinary bow or crossbow. Broken limbs and damaged trigger assemblies need separate repair. Payment records the commissioned work; the GM decides completion and applies any item changes manually.

requirements.note: Select one eligible item from your character’s inventory. It stays with the character.

services.saleUnit: One bow or crossbow

services.name: Replace Shield Straps
services.description: Replace worn leather straps and fastenings, then check the grip. The shield body is not replaced. Payment records the commissioned work; the GM decides completion and applies any item changes manually.

requirements.note: Select one eligible item from your character’s inventory. It stays with the character.

services.saleUnit: One shield

services.name: Custom Fitting
services.description: Refine an intact suit’s padding, straps and articulation for its wearer. The wearer must attend; this does not remove proficiency requirements, Strength requirements or Stealth disadvantage. Payment records the commissioned work; the GM decides completion and applies any item changes manually.

requirements.note: Select one eligible item from your character’s inventory. It stays with the character.

services.saleUnit: One suit and one fitting appointment

services.name: Basic Appraisal
services.description: Inspect visible workmanship, condition and materials and offer a practical resale estimate. This is not magical identification and does not reveal curses or hidden enchantments. Payment records the commissioned work; the GM decides completion and applies any item changes manually.

requirements.note: Select one eligible item from your character’s inventory. It stays with the character.

services.saleUnit: One item

services.name: Identify Potion
services.description: Examine one potion and report its properties as determined by the GM. This is an appraisal service, not an automatic Identify spell, and does not automatically reveal curses or toggle the Item identified field. Approval records payment for commissioned work; the GM confirms completion.

requirements.note: Select the supplied item. It remains in your inventory; the GM checks suitability and completes the work.

services.saleUnit: One potion

services.name: Appraise Ingredients
services.description: Inspect a sample for visible quality, useful quantity and likely value. The GM determines conclusions; the service does not guarantee safety or reveal magical properties. Approval records payment for commissioned work; the GM confirms completion.

requirements.note: Select the supplied item. It remains in your inventory; the GM checks suitability and completes the work.

services.saleUnit: One sample

services.name: Refill Vial
services.description: Decant a supplied mundane liquid into a supplied clean vial. Liquid and vessel are not included; this does not replenish a consumed potion. The GM checks container suitability and records the transfer manually. Approval records payment for commissioned work; the GM confirms completion.

requirements.note: Select the supplied item. It remains in your inventory; the GM checks suitability and completes the work.

services.saleUnit: One small vessel

services.name: Distill Alcohol
services.description: Commission workshop distillation of suitable supplied material. Agree the output and completion time with the GM before approval. Inputs are not automatically consumed and no saleable spirit Item is generated. Approval records payment for commissioned work; the GM confirms completion.

requirements.note: Select the supplied item. It remains in your inventory; the GM checks suitability and completes the work.

services.saleUnit: One small batch, up to one pint of supplied liquid

services.name: Grind Herbs
services.description: Grind a supplied dried herb packet to an agreed texture and return it wrapped. This does not brew a potion or increase the ingredients value automatically. The GM records the finished preparation. Approval records payment for commissioned work; the GM confirms completion.

requirements.note: Select the supplied item. It remains in your inventory; the GM checks suitability and completes the work.

services.saleUnit: One herb packet
